decisions.reason: As a close-to-core perfect binder in a growing finishing market, it is still worth keeping because the cost of carrying it in a broad portfolio is likely modest, although its more standard positioning makes it somewhat more expendable than the others.
The fully automatic perfect binder fits the firm's stated focus on automation, productivity and digital-print finishing, so with no clear negative signal it remains a valuable option to keep open.

The booklet maker for inline and nearline applications matches the firm's direction toward integrated digital finishing and complements its service-led portfolio, making abandonment relatively unlikely absent evidence of weak demand.
